The severely shortened ṭhoṛā forms are qualified comparisons with the local hathoṛā family; unrelated hammer responses and mixed alternatives are excluded.

Turner musala explicitly supplies Gujarati musḷũ, Marathi musaḷ, Punjabi muhlā/mohlā and Sindhi muhurī pestle. Turner treats the word as probably non-Aryan in ultimate origin; this link does not invent an immediate Dravidian donor.
